one_liner: Emote_Rom_1 syncs player emotes across a Hyperfy world, showing emoji UI indicators and supporting numpad-triggered animations.
primary_use_case: Enable players to trigger and broadcast custom emote animations with visual emoji cues in multiplayer sessions.
preview_recommendation: Add a screenshot or short video showing the emoji UI indicator above a player during an emote, and include a preview of the emote animation assets.
manifest_quality_notes: Script includes both client and server logic
